text:
deploybot: Preflight for cross-service wave starting now. Targeted pins: api=v2.3.0, runtime=v1.12.4-rc2, console=v0.9.7, router=v1.8.0. Change window 2026-03-22 01:00-03:00 UTC. Running pin walk: api -> runtime -> router -> console. Reply 'hold' to stop.

amanda: runtime here — thumbs up for v1.12.4-rc2. Includes KV eviction fix and improved cache cold-start. I'll shadow-canary for 30m first. Pin command I used locally: `deployctl pin service=runtime version=1.12.4-rc2 commit=abcd1234`

jon: api: ACK v2.3.0. Note: session header schema bump (X-Redwood-Session v2) — console must accept it. No client breaker expected but added to release notes.

ryan: console: ACK. v0.9.7 includes session v2 compatibility behind a feature flag `console.accept_session_v2`. I will flip the flag during canary.

kim: router: rolling config to passthrough new session header and keep header-compat shim ready (router-header-shim v1). Will pin router to 1.8.0 and keep shim pinned as automatic fallback.

maria: sre-oncall signal: Observability thresholds set — abort if p99 latency > 180ms OR error rate > 0.5% across api/runtime for sustained 5m. I'll monitor.

deploybot: Preflight checks passed: infra quotas OK, canary capacity available. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with hold checks at each step. Canary windows 10m / 20m / 15m respectively. Rolling order enforced: api first, then runtime, router, console.

amanda: Add note: runtime fallback variant = runtime-quantized v1.12.3-quant. Auto-fallback will trigger on OOM/latency spike. Rollback playbook ready.

jon: I'll open a docs PR for release notes (schema section + migration notes) and tag @docs. Add a 'pinned-48h' note to the release metadata.

sre-oncall: :rotating_light: I'll hold at 5% if any spike. Watching dashboards and traces.

deploybot: Canary started: 5% traffic (api:v2.3.0 + runtime:v1.12.4-rc2). Canary trace: https://deploy.redwood.ai/trace/6161616162

ryan: flipped `console.accept_session_v2` = true for 5% canary. :thumbsup:

kim: router rollout started on edge fleet, 100 hosts updated so far, no config errors :eyes:

maria: early telemetry: p50/p95 stable, p99 ~130ms. Error rate 0.02%. continuing watch.

jon: Reminder: If we need to revert quickly, rollback runtime first (it’s stateless for this change). Quick rollback command: `deployctl rollback service=runtime to_version=1.12.3 --reason=canary-latency`

amanda: Confirmed, rollback playbook link: /ops/runbooks/runtime_canary_rollback.md (has steps for cache warmup and KV eviction mitigation).

sre-oncall: If no new errors, approve move to 25% in 5m.

deploybot: Advancing to 25% canary. Initiating router pin to 1.8.0 now.

kim: Router at 25% of routers updated, config checks green. No routing anomalies.

ryan: Console flag set to 25%. Monitoring client acceptance in realtime logs.

maria: p99 trending down to 125ms, error rate steady at 0.03%. Looks healthy.

deploybot: Proceeding to 100% in 15m if no intercepts. Post-canary note: we will keep a pinned-variant window of 48h (no auto-upgrades) to give platform teams time to observe.

jon: Noted. I'll tag release notes and send announcement to #announcements after final completion.

sre-oncall: :thumbsup: Preparing a rollback incident template in case we need it — will attach if triggered.

deploybot: Rollout complete to 100% at ts=6161616180. No rollbacks triggered. Closing wave and enabling 48h pinned window. If any post-rollout regressions, open channel #incidents and reference trace id 6161616162.
